resources.string: Silently texts your emergency contacts with your location, and keeps updating it.
Dial a short code to really call this person.
Sends your message to this person.
Texts this person a map link to where you are.
Sends your message on WhatsApp. Your phone must be unlocked.
Turns on, and turns off when you dial again.
Rings loudly, even on silent, until you unlock it or dial again.
Sends the battery level to your watch.
Controls whatever is playing on your phone.
Skips to the next song or episode.
Switches your phone between ringing and vibrating.
Turns Do Not Disturb on or off.
Calls a web address, such as a smart home automation.
Turns your mobile hotspot on or off.
Talk to an AI assistant from your watch, with your own free key.
Switches a light, plug, fan or air conditioner in your home.
Digix is off. Code %1$s did not run.

Could not reach that web address.
Add a web address in Digix first.
Choose a device in Digix first.

%1$s isn\'t in your Google Home anymore.

Wi-Fi needs setup. Open Digix to finish.
This code needs a contact. Open Digix to finish.
Texts need your permission. Open Digix to allow it.
Location sharing needs your permission. Open Digix to allow it.
Couldn\'t find your location. Check that location is on.
WhatsApp needs the Digix helper. Open Digix to finish.
Unlock your phone to send on WhatsApp.
I feel unsafe and need help. Please call me or come to me.
Finding my location now. It will follow in another message.
I can\'t get my location right now. %1$s
My Digix alert has stopped, so I\'m no longer sharing my location.

It couldn\'t find my location for this test.
The assistant can\'t start during a call.

Digix can\'t use the microphone. Open Digix on your phone to allow it.
Your assistant key didn\'t work. Check it in Digix.
You\'ve reached your provider\'s limit for now. Try again later.
I can\'t reach the assistant. Check your phone\'s connection.
Locking needs setup. Open Digix to finish.
Could not reach the control. Unlock your phone and try again.
The phone did not confirm the change. Unlock it and try again.
Tells your watch what happened after you dial a code.
Shown while an action is running.
Unlock your phone to stop it.
Hang up on your watch to end it.
Dial the code again to turn it off.

Lets your watch switch Quick Settings tiles such as Hotspot, and press Send in WhatsApp when you dial a WhatsApp code. Digix only looks at the Quick Settings panel and WhatsApp, only while doing these things. It reads nothing else on your screen.
Your watch can already do this.
Dial a short code on your watch. Your phone runs the action and tells you it\'s done. Nothing goes over your phone network, and your watch needs no app.
Let Digix see the numbers you dial.
To catch a code before it becomes a call, Android needs to pass each dialed number to Digix first.
Every other call goes through untouched.
Numbers are never saved or sent anywhere.
A code never interrupts a real call.
Next, tap Digix, then Set as default, then allow phone access.
Digix cannot work without this. You can allow it any time.
Let Digix start when you dial.
Allow this so your codes work while your phone is locked or in a pocket.
That worked because Digix was open. Allow this so your codes also work while your phone is locked or in a pocket.
Android will call this running in the background. Digix only starts when you dial a code.
See the result on your wrist.
After each code, Digix sends a short notification, and your watch shows it if it mirrors your phone\'s notifications.
Now dial this on your watch.
Open the dial pad, enter %1$s, and press call. Your flashlight will turn on, and your watch will tell you.
Nothing yet? Check that your watch is connected to this phone over Bluetooth. You can also dial the code on your phone.
Nothing went over your phone network. Dial %1$s again to turn the flashlight off.
These codes are ready. You can change them, or add Hotspot, Wi-Fi and more, in the app.
Codes marked Needs setup will run once you finish setting them up in the app.
Digix can\'t see your codes yet.
Add a code to control your phone from your watch.
So your watch can connect to the reply, and a code never interrupts a real call.
Your codes will be dialed as real numbers until you allow this. On the next screen, tap Digix, then Set as default.
Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
Android needs your permission for this action.
Allow Digix to start when you dial
Android needs your permission for this action.
After you delete this, dialing %1$s places a real call.
Android restricts this on newer versions. Digix picks the simplest route your phone allows.
Android only lets an accessibility helper lock the screen for you.
Turn on the switch for Digix, then come back. It works even while your phone is locked, with no other setup.
Shizuku is running on this phone, so Digix can switch this directly, even while your phone is locked. No other steps are needed.
Find Digix helper in the list and turn it on. The helper uses Accessibility to run the specific actions you set up.
Open App info, tap the menu at the top, choose Allow restricted settings, then come back and try again.
Quick Settings will open. Tap the tile once so Digix learns its name on your phone. This also switches it, so tap again afterward if you need to.
Tap the tile in Quick Settings
This works while your phone is unlocked. Android usually blocks these tiles on the lock screen, and Digix will tell you if that happens.
Choose your home and allow Digix to switch its devices.
Google Home didn\'t connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
No devices to switch. Lights, plugs, fans and air conditioners you can control in Google Home appear here.
Couldn\'t load your devices. Check your internet connection.
Turns it on if it\'s off, and off if it\'s on.
Android needs your permission for this action.

WhatsApp has no way for apps to send by themselves, so Digix opens the chat and taps Send. Your phone must be unlocked, and it\'s not suitable for emergencies. Use your own number\'s country code. WhatsApp may not allow automated sending, so use this only for your own messages.
Android blocked this for an app not installed from a store. Open App info, tap the menu at the top, choose Allow restricted settings, then come back and try again.
Dial this code if you feel unsafe. With no sound, your contacts get a text with your location, then updates every 5 minutes for an hour. Dial it again to stop.
Off. Your contacts won\'t get your location.
Recommended. Stops your phone from pausing updates.
After the texts go out. They could hear what\'s around you.
If Android blocked this, open App info, tap the menu at the top, choose Allow restricted settings, then come back and try again.
It runs even if Digix is switched off. Your watch stays silent, and the only notification just says Done. Texts use your normal SMS plan, and each update goes to every contact.
SOS needs mobile signal, and doesn\'t contact emergency services. If you\'re in danger and can, call your local emergency number. Send a test now so you know it works.
Test sent to %1$d, with your location. Ask them to check it arrived.
Test sent to %1$d, but your location wasn\'t found. Try again outdoors.
Only %1$d of %2$d test texts went out. Check your signal and those numbers.
Sharing your location with your contacts.
Dial its code on your watch and just talk. Paste a key from a provider below, and you\'re done.
Any service with OpenAI-style chat and transcription.
What you say goes to the provider you choose, using your key, under their terms. Free plans may use your conversations to improve their products. Your key stays encrypted on this phone.
That key or model didn\'t work. Check it and try again.
The key works, but you\'ve reached the provider\'s limit for now.
Couldn\'t reach the provider. Check your connection and the address.
The provider sent a reply Digix couldn\'t read.
Codes you dial will appear here, with what happened. Only your codes are recorded, never other numbers.
Your watch answers, says what happened, and hangs up.
Feel a response when you use this app.
Not allowed. Flashlight and Find my phone can\'t run.
On. Results reach your watch if it mirrors your phone.
Off. Your watch won\'t show results.
On. Switches Hotspot and Wi-Fi tiles, and locks your phone.
Off. Needed for Lock phone, and for Hotspot and Wi-Fi without Shizuku.
The short call your watch hears stays inside your phone. It uses no minutes and stays out of your call history. Your phone may show it for a moment.
Android shows Digix each number you dial, for a moment, before the call starts. Numbers that aren\'t your codes pass straight through, and aren\'t saved.
Emergency calls are never touched, and a code can never be an emergency number.
Digix doesn\'t run in the background. Android starts it only when you dial.
If you remove Digix, its codes become ordinary dialed numbers.
You can also add a Digix tile to Quick Settings to switch it on or off.
SOS couldn’t start. Check the permissions and try the SOS test in DigiX.

DigiX uses Accessibility to read Quick Settings labels and tap the tiles you choose, lock the screen, and find and tap Send in WhatsApp when you dial a WhatsApp shortcut. The helper does not send screen content to DigiX servers. You can turn it off in Android settings.
Location when the app is closed

DigiX uses your location while an SOS is active, even when the app is closed, to text updates to your chosen contacts. To enable this, open Permissions, select Location, then choose Allow all the time.

DigiX uses your location when the app is closed if you dial a Share my location code. It sends a map link by text to the contact you chose for that code. To enable this, open Permissions, select Location, then choose Allow all the time.
Use an HTTPS address for your voice provider.
